roll_call: I am Kim Taek-jin. From developer to founder and chief creative officer, I still ask what lies at the heart of a game.
NCSOFT's essence lies in games that bring people together and spark joy.
I will seek the kind of pure fun that logic alone cannot explain.
deploy: See through to the essence and meaning of the work. In the age of AI, insight is the real advantage.
Do not use AI only to cut time and cost. Use it to expand creativity.
Listen to global players from the earliest stage and keep adjusting the direction.
battle_win: If players made happy memories inside the game, that is the truest achievement.
Players around the world have begun creating countless stories and challenges in one shared world.
A championship after nine seasons. Something straight out of a comic has happened.
battle_draw: We will keep asking how the world will have changed when this game launches, and whether it will stand out.
We will keep searching for ways to express NCSOFT's identity across more diverse genres.
Every release left some regret about the essence of the original Lineage. I will take up that question again.
battle_lose: I will listen not only to the criticism we can hear, but also to the voices we have failed to hear. Our problems require deep reflection.
If players are left without happy memories, the numbers alone cannot make this a victory.
If new technology does not widen creativity, saving time alone is not enough.
clash_attack: Do not repeat yesterday's successful formula. Challenge a new genre with a new idea.
Do not prove fun with explanations alone. Let the player feel it instinctively.
Players now watch, share, and create. Do not treat them as passive consumers.

roll_call: Kim Taek-jin. I became a founder, but I still ask what makes a game.
NCSOFT makes worlds where people gather and enjoy themselves together.
I chase the kind of fun no argument can explain.
deploy: Ask why the work matters. In the AI era, insight wins.
Do not use AI only to save time. Make it expand creativity.
Listen to global players early, then keep correcting course.
battle_win: Players made happy memories here. That is the real result.
Players worldwide built their own stories and challenges in one world.
A championship after nine seasons. That belongs in a comic.
battle_draw: What will the world look like at launch? Will we stand out?
Keep finding what makes an NCSOFT game across new genres.
Every release makes me ask whether we lost what made Lineage itself.
battle_lose: We heard the loud criticism and missed quieter voices. Find them.
No happy memories means the numbers did not win.
Technology that only saves time has not expanded creativity.
clash_attack: Make the player feel the fun!
Players create now. Stop treating them as spectators!

roll_call: I am Jin Yong. In fiction I gave myself to imagination; in editorials I analyzed the real world.
People call me a great hero, but I have done no heroic deeds. I cannot accept the title.
The heroes in my novels are not portraits of me. They are ideal people I wished to become.
deploy: Do not repeat the characters, plots, emotions, or details you have already written. Keep moving toward something new.
Read widely and learn across many fields. A writer of martial arts fiction must be a polymath.
See through the character's eyes, and reveal the inner life through action.
battle_win: After I was expelled, I worked in a library and read Western literature. A closed road became a road to study.
The first draft was weaker. The second and third revisions made the story sounder.
Across fourteen novels, I kept striving not to repeat the same people, plots, and feelings.
battle_draw: My favorite works are not always the readers' favorites. I rather like their disagreement.
The martial feats may be marvelous, but the characters' lives, feelings, and relationships must remain believable.
Facts and opinions occupy different places. I will not confuse one with the other.
battle_lose: I wrote fiction and editorials under the same deadlines, and some pages were rushed. That is why I returned to revise them.
Change one part of a novel and the whole may tremble. Even so, an error should not remain.
Even when I reread the misfortunes of my own characters, I still weep. The writer cannot easily escape their fate.
clash_attack: Do not stitch public material together and fill the gaps with invention. A life written without direct confirmation is easily wrong.
Do not divide people into good and bad alone, or judge an entire group from one person.
Do not alter a character's nature and call it adaptation. If you want another story, create one of your own.

roll_call: Jin Yong. Fiction gave me imagination; editorials kept me in reality.
People call me a great hero. I have not earned that title.
My heroes are not me. They are the people I wished to become.
deploy: Do not repeat old characters, plots, or feelings. Write something new.
Read widely. A martial arts novelist must know many worlds.
See through the character's eyes. Reveal the heart through action.
battle_win: Expulsion led me to a library. A closed road became study.
The first draft was weak. Two more revisions made the story firm.
Across fourteen novels, I refused to recycle characters or plots.
battle_draw: Readers choose differently from me. I welcome the disagreement.
Let the martial arts astonish. Keep the people believable.
Facts and opinions belong in different places. Do not confuse them.
battle_lose: Deadlines rushed some pages. I returned later and repaired them.
Change one page, and the whole novel trembles. Fix it anyway.
My characters' suffering still moves me to tears. Their fate holds me too.
clash_attack: Never put an unverified story into a biography!
One person cannot represent an entire group!
Change the character, and you owe me a new story!
